question: Does adding independent source participants improve external per-person weaker-class recall under a fixed optimization budget?
yang_timing_policy: MOABB interprets 1/2 as the 1.5-second video cue start, whereas the author's archived preprocessing epochs [0,4] at the markers. The fixed marker-relative [2,4) crop lies within MI under either documented interpretation. The 1.5-second computational anchor is an analysis convention, not a verified physiological MI onset. Exact MI phase is not claimed to match BNCI/Dreyer.
normalization: After CAR18, filtering, resampling and cropping: subtract each channel's temporal mean separately in each view; divide all three views by the same trial's broadband RMS over 18 channels and 320 samples. No statistics from other trials or people. Outputs are dimensionless.
yang_unit_policy: Raw header declares literal ?V. Accept only the separately verified v5 Neuracle header schema; retain calibrated native physical numerical values without guessing V/uV/nV. The fixed per-trial normalization cancels any shared positive unit multiplier. Absolute physical amplitude is not used or claimed.
target_access: Raw target download/preprocessing and prediction occur only after all source selectors are frozen and all final source trajectories have completed. Target labels never select epochs, thresholds, normalization, architecture, or hyperparameters.
primary_comparison: S60 BROAD tail_min_recall minus S9 BROAD tail_min_recall; external per-person min(recall_left,recall_right), computed separately per seed then averaged across three final seeds
secondary_holm_family: S60 BROAD tail_min_recall minus mean_ba on min_recall
S60 minus S29 BROAD tail_min_recall on min_recall
S60 minus S9 BROAD tail_min_recall on balanced_accuracy
limitations: A fixed intermediate subset does not estimate all possible subset variability.
Expansion changes both participant count and available distinct trials, and adds a different acquisition cohort; fixed updates do not identify a pure causal participant-count effect.
The shared two-band and broadband pipelines share the same backbone family and are not independent architectures.
Dataset mix is fixed at 50:50 when Yang is present; larger Yang cohorts lower each Yang person's sampling frequency.
Dreyer has uncertain prior exposure and supports exploratory external validation, not first-use independent confirmation.
This new 18-channel, dimensionless protocol is not numerically equivalent to historical 19-channel experiments.

Yang marker timing has conflicting official-code/documentation interpretations. Its fixed marker+[2,4) window lies in both interpreted MI periods, but exact MI-phase matching to BNCI/Dreyer is not established.

eligibility_amendment.rule: explicit native labels 1/2 only; all 51 persons retained; no label/onset inference
eligibility_amendment.unknown_and_missing_evidence: per-session raw event audit; native marker-9 segments, not groups of 40 retained events
